# opnsense_systemhealth_settings (Resource)

Health graph collection (**Reporting ▸ Settings**). This is a singleton: import it with the ID `systemhealth_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_systemhealth_settings.this
  id = "systemhealth_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_systemhealth_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables the RRD graphing backend. Note that if disabled, existing RRD data is not deleted. When enabled, starts a cron job that runs every minute, collecting helpful system metrics to be shown in the graph below.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `systemhealth_settings`.
